arguments.command:
cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
import solver, controller, probability
from gen_big import gen_request

rng = random.Random(13)
req = gen_request(rng, ncases=1, J=512, S=256, F=32, G=32)
c = req['cases'][0]
t0 = time.time()
preds = controller._predict(c['model'], c['windows'])
t1 = time.time()
thr = [int(t) for t in probability.window_thresholds(c['stats'], c['windows'])]
t2 = time.time()
print(f'predict {t1-t0:.2f}s thresholds {t2-t1:.2f}s')

stats = {'dij': 0, 'dij_time': 0.0, 'aug': 0, 'spfa': 0, 'spfa_time': 0.0, 'dinic': 0, 'dinic_time': 0.0}
orig_dij = solver.MCF.dijkstra
def dij(self, s, pi):
    t = time.time(); r = orig_dij(self, s, pi)
    stats['dij'] += 1; stats['dij_time'] += time.time() - t
    return r
solver.MCF.dijkstra = dij
orig_spfa = solver.MCF.spfa_pi
def spfa(self, pi):
    t = time.time(); r = orig_spfa(self, pi)
    stats['spfa'] += 1; stats['spfa_time'] += time.time() - t
    return r
solver.MCF.spfa_pi = spfa
orig_df = solver.Dinic.max_flow
def df(self, s, t_):
    t = time.time(); r = orig_df(self, s, t_)
    stats['dinic'] += 1; stats['dinic_time'] += time.time() - t
    return r
solver.Dinic.max_flow = df

t3 = time.time()
res = controller._plan(c, preds, thr)
t4 = time.time()
print(f'plan total {t4-t3:.2f}s')
print(stats)
print('ratio', res['ratio'], 'assigned', sum(1 for a in res['assignment'] if a >= 0))
EOF
